`#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` added to `ReportManualWorkReq`, which was missing the convention its 148 siblings in this file all follow. THE DESIGN HOLDS: the intended behaviour was always that a tool schema forbids unknown params (BL-57) — this restores it rather than changing what reflow2 means to do, so nothing in the design moved.

`test_failure_fix` rather than `defect_fix` because a CHECK ACTUALLY CAUGHT IT: `smoke_mcp.py` in CI, on the assertion "every tool schema forbids unknown params". That distinction is provenance, and it is the one five sessions each guessed differently before these change types existed.

📌 WHY IT REACHED CI. The local run covered a SUBSET of the `full` job's gates and not `smoke_mcp.py`, which is the gate that checks this — the same error class recorded an hour earlier on `ver:a-session-can-report-and-read-back-hand-rolled-work`, where a split cargo run looked equivalent to `--workspace` and was 46 tests short. A subset of a gate set is not the gate set.
